title: Codex wrapper overwrites actual runtime model with placeholder codex
summary: Installed Codex plugin1.118.0 unconditionally sets MCP_SESSION_MODEL=codex in Invoke-CodexMcpPlugin.ps1:123 (also PLUGIN_MODEL_DEFAULT and CT2R_MODEL), while runtime turn_context records identify gpt-6-astra at xhigh. Supported workflow.sessionlog.updateTurn has no model field. Primary MCP records model codex, violating accurate agent/model audit identity. Do not repair historical completed turns automatically.
